data.answer: Yes. Pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive a patent extension, providing **up to 25 years of protection**, rather than the usual maximum of 20 years, according to the 2023 Australian IP Report.[1]

citations.quote: The maximum term of a patent is 20 years, though pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive an extension, providing up to 25 years of protection.

claims.text: The 2023 Australian IP Report states that the usual maximum patent term is 20 years, but pharmaceutical substances experiencing a delay in market approval can receive an extension providing up to 25 years of protection.
